metadata.description: Claude skills I use most weeks, cleaned up so you can install them or build your own.

plugins.name: gdocs-suggest
plugins.description: Claude comments on, copyedits and fills gaps in a Google Doc. Everything it adds is red or marked [Claude].

plugins.name: zotero-librarian
plugins.description: Turns a DOI, arXiv ID, link or half-remembered title into a correctly typed record in your Zotero library.

plugins.name: skill-release
plugins.description: Checks a skill you want to share for private details, like machine names or your email, then copies a cleaned version into a public repo.

plugins.name: research-content
plugins.description: Sends several search agents out at once, each looking somewhere different, and brings back specific leads: videos with timestamps, forum comments, papers, Twitter posts. You say which to follow up.

plugins.name: writing-for-humans
plugins.description: Makes Claude decide what matters before it writes, so the result is plain and sounds like you.

plugins.name: preclear
plugins.description: Before you clear a Claude Code session, Claude saves what's still open to a file, and the next session starts by reading it.

plugins.name: find-session
plugins.description: Finds a past Claude Code session from a half-remembered description and gives you the command to resume it.
